name: Maze Product Options for WooCommerce
author: mazewp

sections.description:
Maze Product Options lets shoppers personalise a product before they buy it: text to engrave, a gift message, a choice of box, gift wrap, a measurement. Each answer can add to the price, per item or once per order line, and every answer follows the order into the cart, checkout, emails and the order screen.

Reusable option sets. Build a set of fields once and apply it to chosen products, whole categories (including sub-categories) or every product, with exclusions. Several sets can apply to one product, in the order you choose.

Nine field types. Text, paragraph, number, email, dropdown, radio buttons, checkboxes, a single checkbox and headings.

Conditional fields. Show a field only when earlier answers call for it, such as a gift message only when gift wrap is checked. Combine up to 10 rules with AND/OR groups. Hidden fields are never required and never charged.

Clear pricing. Give a field or a choice a fixed price, added to each item or once per order line (a set-up fee). Prices follow the product’s tax class and your store’s tax display setting. The product page shows what the options add and the line total as the shopper chooses.

Safe changes. Edit a draft while shoppers see the published version, preview it with real products and the same rules the cart uses, then publish. The latest published version stays live, and each order records the version it was placed with.

Works where WooCommerce works.

  • Simple and variable products, including every variation.
  • Classic themes and block themes using the standard add-to-cart block.
  • The classic cart and checkout, and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Order screens, order emails and My Account, with option prices shown beside the answers.
  • Shop pages and product blocks: a product with a required field shows “Select options” and opens its page.
  • Order again, with answers checked against today’s options.
  • High-performance order storage (HPOS).
  • Personal data export and erasure for answers saved on orders.

Built for store managers. A full-screen workspace under Product Options, and a “Product options” tab on every product listing the sets that apply, with a switch to turn them off for that product.

Option or variation?

Use a variation when the choice has its own stock, SKU, image or price, or must be reported as its own product. Use an option when the shopper types something, picks an extra, or when the combinations would run into hundreds.

For developers

  • Themes can override templates/single-product/maze-product-options/form.php and field.php by copying them to yourtheme/maze-product-options/.
  • Field types and pricing modes can be added through mazewp_mpo_register_field_types and mazewp_mpo_register_pricing_modes; the storefront script exposes window.mazewpMpoForm.registerFieldType() and registerPricingMode().
  • The Store API add-item endpoint accepts answers as mazewp_mpo in the same shape as the form: { "<set id>": { "<field id>": "value" } }.

Privacy

When a shopper places an order, their option answers are stored with the WooCommerce order. Store owners can review, export and erase personal data through WordPress’s privacy tools. The plugin does not send data to an external service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install this plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip, and activate it.
  3. Open Product Options in the admin menu and create your first option set.
  4. Add fields, choose the products or categories in Assignment, check Preview, and publish.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Answers and option prices appear under each line in both the block and the classic cart and checkout.

Does it work with block themes?

Yes, with the standard “Add to Cart with Options” block that block themes use by default. WooCommerce’s beta “Add to Cart + Options” block renders its own form and does not show product options yet; the plugin tells you if your template uses it.

How are coupons applied?

Coupons apply to the whole line price, options included, exactly as WooCommerce applies them to any product price.

What happens to carts when I change an option set?

Shoppers keep their lines if their answers still fit the new version. A line whose answers no longer fit is removed with a notice asking the shopper to add it again.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Option sets are kept unless you turn on “Delete option sets when the plugin is deleted” in Settings. Answers saved on orders are order records and are always kept.

Can a shopper’s answer be HTML?

No. Answers are stored and shown as plain text.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Minor improvements.

1.0.0

  • Added reusable option sets with nine field types: text, paragraph, number, email, dropdown, radio buttons, checkboxes, a single checkbox and headings.
  • Added conditional fields with up to 10 rules combined in AND/OR groups. Hidden fields are never required and never charged.
  • Added per-item and once-per-order-line prices on fields and choices, following the product’s tax class and your store’s tax display setting.
  • Added a live price summary on the product page showing what the options add and the line total.
  • Added draft and published versions of each set, a preview with real products, and a published snapshot recorded on every order.
  • Added assignment of sets to chosen products, whole categories including sub-categories, or every product, with exclusions and a set order.
  • Added support for simple and variable products, classic and block themes, and the classic and block Cart and Checkout.
  • Added answers and option prices to orders, order emails and My Account, plus order again with answers checked against today’s options.
  • Added a “Product options” tab on each product to see the sets that apply and switch them off for that product.
  • Added a full-screen admin workspace for building and managing sets.
  • Added shop-page handling: a product with a required field shows “Select options” and opens its page.
  • Added theme-overridable templates, field type and pricing mode hooks, and a Store API add-item extension for developers.
  • Added WordPress personal data export and erasure for answers saved on orders, and compatibility with high-performance order storage (HPOS).
  • Added an optional setting to delete option sets when the plugin is deleted. Answers saved on orders are always kept.

short_description: Add custom fields, choices and priced extras to WooCommerce products with reusable option sets and AND/OR conditions.
